name: Love is Free!
source:
Have you ever dreamed of dating a Free! character?

It is now possible in Love is Free! the dating simulator based on the anime.

Will you make the right choices to seduce your crush?

[From [url=https://love-is-free.itch.io/love-is-free-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]

你有没有梦想过和一个免费的人约会！特点？

现在在《爱是自由》中这一切都成为可能！基于动漫的约会模拟器。

你会做出正确的选择来引诱你的暗恋对象吗？

[来自[url=https://love-is-free.itch.io/love-is-free-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
